metaTitle: Custom Recycled Cotton Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect
metaDescription: Order custom recycled cotton drawstring backpacks for your brand. Eco-friendly, bulk pricing available. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Recycled cotton drawstring backpacks offer a sustainable alternative to standard nylon or polyester bags, using post-industrial fabric scraps that would otherwise go to waste. The natural cotton texture provides a soft, matte finish that screen printing adheres to cleanly, making your logo stand out without the plastic sheen of synthetics. For trade shows, eco-conscious corporate gifts, or retail merch, these bags signal environmental responsibility while delivering the same lightweight, cinch-top convenience your recipients expect.
heroAltText: Custom recycled cotton drawstring backpacks with screen-printed logo on soft natural fabric, perfect for eco-friendly branding.
